value: Adventure game where you explore a shrine as a micro while avoiding the shrine maidens.

You are invited by your friend Rika to investigate a shrine for your summer project. While making a heap of prayers at a statue, the goddess decides to punish you for your greed, shrinking you down to the size of a speck of dust. In order to return to your previous size you will need to pass several “trials” where you survive encounters with the shrine’s maidens.
